title: Test Plan (metadata)
description: Validates plans/<plan_id>/plan.json. Conditions are NOT embedded here—each condition is a file at conditions/<TCON-id>.json, validated by test-condition.schema.json. The conditions/ directory is the source of truth for the condition list; the harness checks referential integrity (matching plan_id and filename/id, and a condition for every P0 requirement).

plan_id.description: Must match the plans/<plan_id>/ directory name — checked by the harness

component.description: Covered package or module, for example vn.tcbs.halo.matching

risk_tier.description: Assigned by harness routing and copied by the Designer — do not choose it yourself

spec_gaps.description: Specification behavior that is uncovered or ambiguous. Empty when none exists, but the field must always be present so the Designer has to consider it.

description.description: What the gap is; state both interpretations when it is ambiguous
